name: Connectivity Matrix Computation
summary: Computes a structural connectivity matrix between the regions of a volumetric parcellation from an MRtrix tractogram, using MRtrix3 tck2connectome or pairwise tckedit filtering.
description: Parcellation mode of app-retinotopic-connectivity: assigns streamlines of the tractogram to the labels of the input parcellation and counts connections normalized by ROI volume, either with tck2connectome (endpoint assignment, fast) or pairwise tckedit filtering (stricter). Use it to get a region-by-region structural connectome, optionally restricted to a subset of labels. The tractogram and parcellation must be in the same space; the README mainly documents the retinotopic (pRF) mode of the same code.

inputs.requirements: Must be in the same space as the parcellation.

inputs.description: Volumetric parcellation with its label.json (names of voxel values), used as the connectome nodes.
inputs.requirements: Must be in the same space as the tractogram.

outputs.description: PNG figures of the connectivity matrix, listed in images.json.
Connectivity matrix as CSV (streamline density) with index.json and label.json.

parameters.description:
connectome: 
Fast method using MRtrix tck2connectome (endpoint voxel assignment).
pairwise: 
Slower but stricter method using explicit streamline filtering (tckedit).
true → enforce ordered endpoint matching (A→B and B→A computed separately, then merged; used when <area_matrix_method> =  pairwise)

Restrict the parcellation matrix to a subset of atlas labels.

Accepts a comma-separated list of voxel values, inclusive ranges, or names from label.json (case-insensitive).

Examples:
  "1,5,10-20"  → labels 1, 5, and 10 through 20
  "V1,V2,hV4" → named labels from label.json

Leave empty (default) to include all labels.
